attributes.action: remove phone pouches from all schools
attributes.additional_details: i think we should ban phone pouches in all schools due to the inconvenience it causes for example a lot of people around the uk have had there phone broken in phone pouches and another 2 inconveniences are how long it takes to get into school in the morning due to the phone pouches even how long it takes to get out of school having to unlock pouches this causes many disruptions to learning it also causes young people trying to break pouches in class and also making noise with pouches in school
